gold_sql:
SELECT
  p.*,
  ST_Distance(
    ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.304594 43.787343)',4326)::geography,
    p.geometry::geography
  ) AS distance,
  elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(
        p.geometry::geography,
        ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.304594 43.787343)',4326)::geography,
        4300
      )
  AND amenity = 'restaurant';

WITH restaurant_geom AS (

farm_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-70.304594 43.787343)'), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
buffer_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(farm.geom, 4300) AS geom
  FROM farm_geom farm
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(r.rast, b.geom, true) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  JOIN buffer_geom b ON ST_Intersects(r.rast, b.geom::geometry)
),
elevation_stats AS (
  SELECT
    ST_ValueCount(rast, true) AS elevation_stats
  FROM clipped_dem
),
distance_result AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Distance(farm.geom, rest.geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM farm_geom farm, restaurant_geom rest
)
SELECT
  distance_result.distance_meters,
  (elevation_stats.elevation_stats).val AS elevation_meters
FROM distance_result, elevation_stats;
